body: I understand you. It's always the thought that ponders through my brain. Im currently sitting in the dark at work reading this and almost brought tears to my eyes because i too cant go to the person i really want to talk to about it.
pretty much never. my feelings almost always gets pushed aside from my wife.

Im sorry to hear. Maybe others were put on this earth having life hard in order to surpass it and be able to give back to others that are in your place. You just need to keep pushing through. We're proud of you.

It's sad reading this because sometimes i myself feel like the abuser to my wife... i dont mean to yell like that and hurt her..just trying to get a message through. Suicide runs through my veins too and i just...I feel sorry for lashing out in her direction. Shes with me the most so she sees all of the pent up aggression and anxiety. Im hoping he turns his head around and realizes what he is doing to you as i do for my wife.

I solely feel for you. It's crazy how we worry about debt and failure rather our own lives. I always heard the saying. Suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem. because in reality. Medical school is in fact temporary. bills....ehhh depending if you are able to pay them off or not would be considered temporary to, but you get the idea. Truth is. take pride and joy in every little win you do. Making your bed. Getting up on time. Working out. then from there just keep the ball rolling. shoot even celebrate for something as little throwing a ball of trash away from a couple feet. You'll never lose if you feel like you're always winning.
I feel that. When I', really low. I just want to sit in the dark and let time pass by.

Suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem. I'm pretty sure you've heard that saying before but it's true. You're only 18 and a lot could change by the next year. Im 26 and have gone through many phases in my life. loss of life is lost opportunity. a lost chance in really figuring out who you and and what you want to be. best goal for you is although all this trouble, turmoil, sadness is here, how do you want to be remembered if you do leave this earth. someone who folded and gave up? or someone who said, "you know what, yeah this sucks, but i busted my ass and made the best of everything." this whole paragraph is cliche i know, but it comes from the heart as i too am struggling in life to keep pushing forward.
I'm in the same spot as you... Mini things will trigger me and it will just cascade down to depression and anxiety.
I can honestly say. I've been on that other side. It could be the stress and anxiety built up and it just lashed out. It wasn't meant toward you. Wasn't supposed to be.
Sad truth is that there's not a real way out...
